ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U is fact plus accessor/label choice to observation pairs. R selects first field for get/text, all matching IDs for ids and prescribed label fields. U minus R contains text returning a later nonempty same-slot field when the first is empty, and label showing neg/end merely because flags are true.

A fixed label's preimage includes every Fact differing only in omitted fields (neg,end,by,line,sent,who and unrendered slots). Attr/Have/Part additionally constrain rendered first Value; other kinds do not. Formatting may introduce further ambiguity.
has_id(i) is true iff i occurs in who or any field.ids. src alone does not make it true; repeated occurrences do not change this Boolean even though ids returns duplicates.
For repeated slot fields, get observes only the first while ids flattens all. Reordering fields can change text without changing ID multiset; therefore replacing ids by get.ids is not equivalent.

Predicate matching reads the first Pred field only, whereas word matching takes maximum over every field, including later Pred fields. A later matching Pred can add 1.5 to a word group without setting pred. Similarly text returns None on an empty first field while ids still concatenates later field IDs. These projections cannot be substituted for one another.

coverage.description: Project fact fields through get/text/ids, test entity membership and format a human label with anchors and optional cause.
